newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH GRAIN MILLING FIRM CLEARED FOR OTC TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH GRAIN MILLING FIRM CLEARED FOR OTC TRADE.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared grain processor Przedsiebiorstwo Zbozowo-Mlynarskie w Boleslawcu (PZZ Boleslawiec) 1,207,080 shares for public trade, KPW said in a statement on Thursday.

The company, which seeks regulated over-the-counter OTC market Centralna Tabela Ofert (CTO) listing had a net profit of 2.9 million zlotys on 44.2-million-zloty sales in the first nine months of 1996.
Its main shareholders are National Investment Fund (NFI) No 11, which has 33-percent of shares and the state treasury which has 25 percent of shares. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
